fixes_applied.action: Split run_cycle() into 5 sub-functions (_run_objects, _run_commitments, _run_leads, _run_entities) plus isolated process_inbound/deliver_messages. Each wrapped in try/except. Added _safe_rollback() between sections to clear aborted transactions.
Replaced blocking while+time.sleep(5) generator with instant JSON response. Returns {"status": "disabled"} — frontend falls back to polling (GET /api/v1/reality).
db.session.commit() now wrapped in try/except and ALWAYS executes. Return dict includes 'status' (completed|partial) and 'errors' array.

remaining_known_issues.desc: leads.entity_id column missing in DB (model has it, table doesn't) — _run_leads crashes silently, logged in errors[]
entities.type column missing — _run_entities crashes silently, logged in errors[]
messages.direction column missing — deliver_messages crashes silently, logged in errors[]
'Object' object has no attribute 'type' — uses object_type instead, per-object error logged

architectural_improvements: Loop Atomicity Principle: each processing domain is an atomic, crash-isolated unit
Crash Isolation Architecture: section failures never cascade to other sections
Execution Completion Guarantee: commit always fires, status always returned
Safe Rollback Protocol: _safe_rollback() clears aborted transactions between sections
